payload.blocks: Only P6 (what leaves AGENTS.md). The door, the seam contract and the first increment keep being shaped.
payload.headline: Should the agent-start seam also cover the AgentKit, GitNexus and MDView text in AGENTS.md, or only fgOS's own?

parts.cause: Three read-only sweeps measured every always-loaded file and its writer (DISCUSSION.md §3 #ambient). The AgentKit installer rewrote its block and .claude/rules on 2026-11-09 (334d66ed8). Because of that, the Oct 17 advice to drop .claude/rules (08244d2ba) never took effect.

options.cost: AGENTS.md hand part from ~20.7 KB to ~5 KB; the projection block becomes domain-targeted; no change outside this repo.
options.does: The seam owns fgOS's own doctrine. AGENTS.md keeps a short standing sheet by the L8 test, and the rest moves behind the seam. AgentKit's double load and Codex's 32 KiB cut become a separate backlog item.
options.gain: fgOS stays out of other tools' installers. The cut stays inside code fgOS owns. Owner sessions opened by hand keep the AgentKit rules.
options.harm: About 9.9k tokens of third-party text stays at every start until that separate item lands.
options.label: fgOS text only; third-party mess is a separate item

options.cost: Plus an install guard or a post-install rewrite per tool, a doctor row each, and a re-check after every AgentKit or GitNexus upgrade.
options.does: fgOS stops AgentKit, GitNexus and MDView from writing into AGENTS.md and .claude/rules. It injects only the parts that fit each role through the seam.
options.gain: The largest cut: AGENTS.md could fall under ~4k tokens and the duplicate disappears.
options.harm: fgOS starts governing other tools' installs. Each tool upgrade can write its blocks back. Sessions opened by hand lose those rules.
options.label: Seam owns third-party text too

parts.recommendation: fgOS text only, with the third-party duplication filed as its own item. It shapes the seam inside code fgOS owns and still removes the larger fgOS share. Whether to govern AgentKit is a separate choice about another tool.

scope.allows: Shaping P6 to move fgOS-owned AGENTS.md text behind the seam by the L8 test, and asking the secretary to file the third-party duplication and Codex truncation as a separate item.
scope.forbids: Any edit to AGENTS.md, .claude/rules or another tool's install now; this only settles the discussion's scope.

parts.what: Claude loads about 17k tokens of always-loaded instructions at every start in this repo. fgOS writes only about 7.7k of that. AgentKit writes about 8.4k: the same rules twice, once in AGENTS.md and once in .claude/rules. GitNexus and MDView add about 1.5k. Moving fgOS's own text behind the seam saves at most about 6k tokens per start.
